blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Monetary Policy Statement 2026-27 (62nd MPC Meeting Highlights). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: The MPC balances inflation control with economic growth momentum, setting benchmark interest rates for FY27.

📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
MPC held 62nd meeting from August 3 to 5, 2026.
Chairmanship: **Sanjay Malhotra** (RBI Governor).
**Repo Rate:** Kept unchanged at **5.25%**.

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
**Real GDP Growth Projection (FY 2026-27):** Projected at **6.7%** (Q1 7.0%, Q2 6.4%, Q3 6.5%, Q4 6.8%).
**CPI (consumer price index tracking retail inflation) Inflation Projection (FY 2026-27):** Lowered to **5.0%** (earlier 5.1%) (Q2 4.7%, Q3 5.9%, Q4 5.5%). Core inflation projected at **4.3%**.
Macro Buffers: Gross FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) inflows at **US$ 30.7 billion** in Q1 FY27; Forex reserves import cover **over 10 months**.
Real GDP Growth projection (6.7%) vs CPI (consumer price index tracking retail inflation) Inflation projection (5.0%) for FY27.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on Repo Rate figure (5.25%), MPC stance ('Neutral'), MSME collateral-free threshold, and inflation forecast.

blocks.title: 💼 Interview Question & Model Answer
blocks.text:
**Q:** Why has the MPC maintained a 'Neutral' stance amidst global macroeconomic uncertainties?

**Model Answer:** A neutral stance provides the RBI flexibility to balance domestic growth with inflation targets while monitoring global commodity price volatility.
